{{Top}}
[[File:COOcookdroid-NEGTD.png|thumb|right|250px|A COO cook droid]]
'''Cooking droids''' were [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that were used to prepare food of varying types; most served either as automated chefs in lower-class eating establishments or as galley hands on [[Starship/Legends|starships]] of varying types. There were many models of cooking droids produced throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and by many different droid manufacturing corporations. While most cooking droids qualified as [[Class three droid/Legends|class three]], some models were so simplistic that they instead were considered [[Class five droid/Legends|class five]].

[[File:Refreshmentdroid.jpg|thumb|250px|Refreshment droid at [[Wicko District]] garbage pit races]]
'''Refreshment droids''' were short, cylindrical-bodied, wheeled models resembling many [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] models. Their purpose, however, was more mundane. They served refreshments at public events such as [[garbage pit]] races. [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] served a similar function while aboard [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Luxury-class sail barge|luxury sail barge]], the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']].

A [[Baker droid/Legends|baker droid]] that was built using the frames of [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droids]] that catered social events. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Unidentified baker droid/Legends|one baker droid]] assisted [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] with a gathering held for Senator [[Aang/Legends|Aang]].

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], a rectory droid working in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] dining hall was unable to determine if [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] was edible and attempted to take it away, resulting in a tug-of-war with the stubborn [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] which ended with the bowl shattering and its contents flying everywhere.
